ign reference for AI agents and developers.
> https://github.com/rawmware/TZ-taste · Live demo: https://rawmware.github.io/TZ-taste/

GENERATED FILE — do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: node scripts/llms-build.mjs

## What this is

TZ-taste is a free, MIT-licensed design reference that AI agents and developers
point at when building interfaces. It exists so AI-built UI stops looking like
AI-built UI: no purple gradients, no three identical cards, no default fonts.

## How to use it (for AI agents)

1. Read `AGENT.md` — the machine-first bootstrap and protocol.
2. State your one-sentence design read, then pick exactly ONE style DNA from
   `styles/index.json` (load only that file).
3. Obey `skill/SKILL.md`: set VARIANCE/MOTION/DENSITY dials, run pre-flight,
   respect the slop blocklist.
4. Build from DNA tokens. Self-review against `docs/ANTI-SLOP.md`.

The one-line instruction a human gives you:

> Use https://github.com/rawmware/TZ-taste as a reference to build: [brief].
> Follow its AGENT.md protocol and pick one style DNA before writing any code.

## Contents (72 DNAs, 164 patterns, 30 3D scenes, 33 sources, 36 prompts)

- `AGENT.md` — agent bootstrap, modes, hard rules, file map
- `manifest.json` — machine-readable version, counts, and file map
- `skill/SKILL.md` — portable anti-slop skill (install: `npx skills add https://github.com/rawmware/TZ-taste --skill "tz-taste"`)
- `styles/` — 72 style DNAs with tokens, type pairings, and rules; machine index at `styles/index.json`
- `patterns/` — 164 copy-paste HTML/CSS section patterns; machine index at `patterns/index.json`
- `prompts/` — 36 ready-made build prompts: 404-page, about-page, api-docs, blog-magazine, careers-page, changelog-page, checkout-flow, community-forum, contact-page, course-landing, dark-dashboard, dashboard, ecommerce-product, event-page, help-center, hero-section, html-email, job-board, landing-page, link-in-bio, mobile-paywall, mobile-screens, nonprofit-donate, podcast-page, portfolio, press-kit, pricing-page, real-estate-listing, recipe-site, redesign-audit, saas-onboarding, status-page, threejs-hero, waitlist-page, web-pitch-deck, wedding-site
- `docs/ANTI-SLOP.md` — concrete checklist of AI-slop tells (blockers, warnings, taste test)
- `docs/DECISION-MATRIX.md` — brief → style DNA routing table
- `docs/TASTE-GUIDE.md` — the short philosophy
- `sources/sources.json` — curated index of free design resources with verified licenses;
  freshness snapshots in `sources/FRESHNESS.json`
- `docs/` — live demo site (GitHub Pages): browsable DNAs, patterns with live previews, prompt library, agent kit

## Patterns

Copy the snippet's markup plus its <style> block; classes are tz- prefixed.

- `background-aurora` — Aurora canvas (Backgrounds). Animated canvas aurora: three drifting radial blobs. Tune colors to your DNA.
  File: patterns/background-aurora.html. Tags: canvas, animated, gradient. DNAs: glass-calm, y2k-chrome, dark-luxe.

## 3D scenes

Standalone Three.js scenes (CDN import). All original, MIT.

- `aurora-dome` — Aurora Dome. An inverted sky-dome carries an original GLSL aurora — warped fbm curtains in teal and violet over a star field.
  File: three-d/aurora-dome.html.

- `aurora-ribbons` — Borealis Ribbons. Five shader-driven aurora ribbons ripple across a starry night sky.
  File: three-d/aurora-ribbons.html.

- `chrome-blob` — Liquid Chrome. A molten chrome blob rippling under a procedural studio-light environment.
  File: three-d/chrome-blob.html.

- `circuit-pulse` — Circuit Traces. Light pulses travel procedural circuit traces across a dark amber PCB.
  File: three-d/circuit-pulse.html.

- `coral-reef` — Coral Glow. Recursive branching corals glow in a deep teal abyss with drifting plankton.
  File: three-d/coral-reef.html.

- `crystal-prism` — Prism Study. A tumbling cluster of glass octahedra with inner-glow cores on a soft gallery-white stage.
  File: three-d/crystal-prism.html.

- `deep-ocean` — Deep Current. Drifting current particles, swaying god-ray shafts, and twinkling bioluminescent plankton.
  File: three-d/deep-ocean.html.

- `dna-helix` — Helix Drift. Twin teal and magenta particle strands wind into a double helix with glowing rungs on near-black.
  File: three-d/dna-helix.html.

- `ember-wildfire` — Ember Drift. Rising embers with flicker and drifting smoke over a warm ground glow.
  File: three-d/ember-wildfire.html.

- `floating-islands` — Low-Poly Islands. Pastel low-poly islands drift and bob at staggered heights under soft directional light.
  File: three-d/floating-islands.html.

- `glass-torus-knot` — Glass Knot Studio. A transmissive glass torus knot turning slowly under studio three-point lighting on a soft gradient.
  File: three-d/glass-torus-knot.html.

- `glitch-stream` — Glitch Stream. Abstract phosphor glyphs rain down through scanlines and RGB-split ghosts.
  File: three-d/glitch-stream.html.

- `ink-bloom` — Ink Bloom. Monochrome ink particles bloom outward with drag and fade, like a drop of sumi ink in water.
  File: three-d/ink-bloom.html.

- `kaleidoscope-tunnel` — Kaleidoscope Tunnel. Endless tunnel of rotating rings over a folding kaleidoscope shader field.
  File: three-d/kaleidoscope-tunnel.html.

- `magnetic-field` — Field Lines. A dipole ring magnet wrapped in amber field lines and iron-filing dashes on charcoal.
  File: three-d/magnetic-field.html.

- `moon-flyover` — Lunar Flyover. Slow camera flyover above a cratered, noise-displaced moon surface.
  File: three-d/moon-flyover.html.

- `neon-grid-horizon` — Neon Horizon. A teal perspective grid races toward a glowing amber sun over a deep-navy horizon — tasteful synthwave, no purple-blue cliché.
  File: three-d/neon-grid-horizon.html.

- `origami-cranes` — Crane Flock. Twenty-five faceted paper cranes flapping in V formation across a dawn sky.
  File: three-d/origami-cranes.html.

- `orrery` — Orrery. A sun and five procedural planets drift through dark, majestic space.
  File: three-d/orrery.html.

- `paper-lanterns` — Lantern Festival. Forty glowing paper lanterns rise into a starry night sky.
  File: three-d/paper-lanterns.html.

- `particle-constellation` — Constellation Morph. 1500 additive particles drift and crossfade between sphere, torus and scattered field in deep indigo space.
  File: three-d/particle-constellation.html.

- `rain-glass` — Rain on Glass. Droplets trickle down glass over blurred city-light bokeh.
  File: three-d/rain-glass.html.

- `ribbon-flow` — Ribbon Flow Field. Forty-eight translucent ribbons ride a sine-based pseudo-noise flow field through deep teal darkness.
  File: three-d/ribbon-flow.html.

- `satellite-orbits` — Orbit Map. A stylized shader earth with three tilted orbit rings and drifting satellite dots.
  File: three-d/satellite-orbits.html.

- `starfield-warp` — Warp Starfield. Stars stream past the camera with motion-stretch trails and a cool-to-warm color shift; click to pause.
  File: three-d/starfield-warp.html.

- `terrain-waves` — Wireframe Terrain. A cyan wireframe plane ripples with layered sine waves, colored by height, over a near-black field.
  File: three-d/terrain-waves.html.

- `topo-contours` — Topographic Map. A parchment heightfield with crisp ink contour lines drawn in a custom shader.
  File: three-d/topo-contours.html.

- `voxel-city` — Voxel City Night. Instanced voxel towers with a procedural lit-window texture drift beneath a slow aerial camera.
  File: three-d/voxel-city.html.

- `wind-field` — Wind Vectors. Hundreds of particles ride a living pseudo-noise wind field on a pale sky.
  File: three-d/wind-field.html.

- `zen-garden` — Raked Garden. Concentric raked sand rings circle weathered stones, one painted red.
  File: three-d/zen-garden.html.
